definitions.explanation: Prolonged worry or care that wears a person down, often about family, work or illness.

examples.japanese: {心労|しんろう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|かさ}なった→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{心労|しんろう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: My mother collapsed from the strain of worry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長引|ながび}き→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧、⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{心労|しんろう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きかった→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: As their son's illness dragged on, the strain on his parents was great.

notes:
A written, somewhat formal word for worry that takes a physical toll; in speech people more often say ⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧ or {気苦労|きぐろう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心労|しんろう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|かさ}なる→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧: worries pile up
- {心労|しんろう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: to collapse from strain
- {心労|しんろう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける: to cause someone worry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧: worry — the everyday word
- ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧: hardship, trouble — the effort and suffering, not only the worry
- ⟦{新郎|しんろう}→新郎：12982_shinrou⟧: bridegroom — same reading, unrelated
